lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ₂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee₂ mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਊਚੇ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਲ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mohan tere ooche ma(n)dar mahal apaaraa ||
lines.translation: O Mohan, your temple is so lofty, and your mansion is unsurpassed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਦੁਆਰ ਜੀਉ ਸੰਤ ਧਰਮ ਸਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mohan tere sohan duaar jeeu sa(n)t dharam saalaa ||
lines.translation: O Mohan, your gates are so beautiful. They are the worship-houses of the Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਸਾਲ ਅਪਾਰ ਦੈਆਰ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਦਾ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਵਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dharam saal apaar daiaar thaakur sadaa keeratan gaavahe ||
lines.translation: In these incomparable worship-houses, they continually sing Kirtan, the Praises of their Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤਹਾ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jah saadh sa(n)t ikatr hovahi tahaa tujhahi dhiaavahe ||
lines.translation: Where the Saints and the Holy gather together, there they meditate on you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹੋਹੁ ਦੀਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar daiaa maiaa daiaal suaamee hohu deen kripaaraa ||
lines.translation: Be Kind and Compassionate, O Merciful Lord; be Merciful to the meek.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak daras piaase mil darasan sukh saaraa ||1||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, I thirst for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; receiving Your Darshan, I am totally at peace. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਬਚਨ ਅਨੂਪ ਚਾਲ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: mohan tere bachan anoop chaal niraalee ||
lines.translation: O Mohan, your speech is incomparable; wondrous are your ways.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਨ ਤੂੰ ਮਾਨਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਜੀ ਅਵਰ ਸਭ ਰਾਲੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: mohan too(n) maanahi ek jee avar sabh raalee ||
lines.translation: O Mohan, you believe in the One. Everything else is dust to you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨਹਿ ਤ ਏਕੁ ਅਲੇਖੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਜਿਨਹਿ ਸਭ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: maanahi ta ek alekh thaakur jinahi sabh kal dhaareeaa ||
lines.translation: You adore the One Lord, the Unknowable Lord and Master; His Power gives Support to all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਚਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਆ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਨਵਾਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tudh bachan gur kai vas keeaa aad purakh banavaareeaa ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Word, you have captured the heart of the Primal Being, the Lord of the World.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਸਭ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) aap chaliaa aap rahiaa aap sabh kal dhaareeaa ||
lines.translation: You Yourself move, and You Yourself stand still; You Yourself support the whole creation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੈਜ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਭ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak paij raakhahu sabh sevak saran tumaareeaa ||2||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, please preserve my honor; all Your servants seek the Protection of Your Sanctuary. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਨ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mohan tudh satasa(n)gat dhiaavai daras dhiaanaa ||
lines.translation: O Mohan, the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, meditates on you; they meditate on the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਨ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਜਪਹਿ ਨਿਦਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mohan jam neR na aavai tudh japahi nidaanaa ||
lines.translation: O Mohan, the Messenger of Death does not even approach those who meditate on You, at the last moment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਗੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੋ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jamakaal tin kau lagai naahee jo ik man dhiaavahe ||
lines.translation: The Messenger of Death cannot touch those who meditate on You single-mindedly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਬਚਨਿ ਕਰਮਿ ਜਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਸੇ ਸਭੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man bachan karam j tudh araadhahi se sabhe phal paavahe ||
lines.translation: Those who worship and adore You in thought, word and deed, obtain all fruits and rewards.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਲ ਮੂਤ ਮੂੜ ਜਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਹੋਤੇ ਸਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਸੁਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mal moot mooR j mugadh hote s dekh daras sugiaanaa ||
lines.translation: Those who are foolish and stupid, filthy with urine and manure, become all-knowing upon gaining the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਜੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਭਗਵਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak raaj nihachal pooran purakh bhagavaanaa ||3||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, Your Kingdom is Eternal, O Perfect Primal Lord God. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਨ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਫਲੁ ਫਲਿਆ ਸਣੁ ਪਰਵਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mohan too(n) suphal phaliaa san paravaare ||
lines.translation: O Mohan, you have blossomed forth with the flower of your family.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਨ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਮੀਤ ਭਾਈ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਭਿ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mohan putr meet bhaaee kuta(n)b sabh taare ||
lines.translation: O Mohan, your children, friends, siblings and relatives have all been saved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾਰਿਆ ਜਹਾਨੁ ਲਹਿਆ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: taariaa jahaan lahiaa abhimaan jinee darasan paaiaa ||
lines.translation: You save those who give up their egotistical pride, upon gaining the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਧੰਨੁ ਕਹਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinee tudhano dha(n)n kahiaa tin jam neR na aaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Messenger of Death does not even approach those who call you 'blessed'.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਅੰਤ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਥੇ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bea(n)t gun tere kathe na jaahee satigur purakh muraare ||
lines.translation: Your Virtues are unlimited - they cannot be described, O True Guru, Primal Being, Destroyer of demons.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਟੇਕ ਰਾਖੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਗਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak tek raakhee jit lag tariaa sa(n)saare ||4||2||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, Yours is that Anchor, holding onto which the whole world is saved. ||4||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ₃ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee₃ mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Fifth Mehl,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਅਸੰਖ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕਰਿ ਪੁਨਹ ਪੁਨਹ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: patit asa(n)kh puneet kar punah punah balihaar ||
lines.translation: Countless sinners have been purified; I am a sacrifice, over and over again, to You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਪਾਵਕੋ ਤਿਨ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਦਾਹਨਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak raam naam jap paavako tin kilabikh daahanahaar ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, meditation on the Lord's Name is the fire which burns away sinful mistakes like straw. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੰਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: chha(n)t ||
lines.translation: Chhant:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨਾ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਮ ਨਰਾਇਣੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਧੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap manaa too(n) raam naraain govi(n)daa har maadho ||
lines.translation: Meditate, O my mind, on the Lord God, the Lord of the Universe, the Lord, the Master of Wealth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਿਆਇ ਮਨਾ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ਮੁਕੰਦੇ ਕਟੀਐ ਕਾਲ ਦੁਖ ਫਾਧੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhiaai manaa muraar muka(n)de kateeai kaal dukh phaadho ||
lines.translation: Meditate, O my mind, on the Lord, the Destroyer of ego, the Giver of salvation, who cuts away the noose of agonizing death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖਹਰਣ ਦੀਨ ਸਰਣ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਅਰਾਧੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: dukhaharan deen saran sreedhar charan kamal araadheeai ||
lines.translation: Meditate lovingly on the Lotus Feet of the Lord, the Destroyer of distress, the Protector of the poor, the Lord of excellence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਪੰਥੁ ਬਿਖੜਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਨਿਮਖ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਾਧੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jam pa(n)th bikhaRaa agan saagar nimakh simarat saadheeai ||
lines.translation: The treacherous path of death and the terrifying ocean of fire are crossed over by meditating in remembrance on the Lord, even for an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਮਲਹ ਦਹਤਾ ਸੁਧੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਅਰਾਧੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: kalimalah dahataa sudh karataa dinas rain araadho ||
lines.translation: Meditate day and night on the Lord, the Destroyer of desire, the Purifier of pollution.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਮਾਧੋ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak karahu kirapaa gopaal gobi(n)d maadho ||1||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, please be Merciful to me, O Cherisher of the world, Lord of the Universe, Lord of wealth. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਮਨਾ ਦਾਮੋਦਰੁ ਦੁਖਹਰੁ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: simar manaa daamodar dukhahar bhai bha(n)jan har raaiaa ||
lines.translation: O my mind, remember the Lord in meditation; He is the Destroyer of pain, the Eradicator of fear, the Sovereign Lord King.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀਰੰਗੋ ਦਇਆਲ ਮਨੋਹਰੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਬਿਰਦਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sreera(n)go daiaal manohar bhagat vachhal biradaaiaa ||
lines.translation: He is the Greatest Lover, the Merciful Master, the Enticer of the mind, the Support of His devotees - this is His very nature.
